decision: Selecting a prompt opens a setup modal instead of starting immediately
why: Style, mode and duration change the session enough to choose deliberately.
value: Sessions match the interview being prepared.

decision: A session can be grounded in an Academy lesson
why: Practice tied to a lesson reinforces what was just learned.

decision: Session quotas are enforced server-side and shown up front
why: A limit discovered mid-session is a broken promise.
value: No surprises; upgrade prompts are honest.

decision: Cards show last score per prompt
why: Progress on a specific prompt motivates the next attempt.
